name: CoreWeave Chester VA

timeline.event: Conversion starts at CTP-01 (Building 1). The data center was formerly owned by Capital One, now leased to CoreWeave. Source: https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/chirisa-secures-200-million-loan-to-fit-out-virginia-data-center-for-co
Building 1's second data hall scheduled to come online this month.
Building 1 is scheduled to be fully online by this point, so we count the full 27 MW as operational here.
Satellite imagery shows Building 1 complete, with Building 2's yard work and early construction visible. Building 3 hasn't started yet, since the old building is still there.
Based on satellite imagery, Building 3 has cleared its land and is beginning construction. Building 2 is operational judging from the colored motion artifacts on the cooling tower fans.
Buildings 3 is estimated complete by the end of Q1 2027, based on the current PowerHouse schedule. Added another three months to account for commissioning and server installation.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: CoreWeave Chester VA: current power 82 MW; owner CoreWeave.

explain: CoreWeave Chester VA is an operating AI data center in Chester, VA, owned by coreweave. Epoch AI estimates it draws 82 MW today and 197 MW when finished.
